name: 北京航空航天大学
character: The main Xueyuan Road campus features 20th-century modern architectural heritage buildings divided into teaching, living, and family zones, with an on-campus park called Lüyuan.

landmarks.name: 绿园
landmarks.quote: 分为南区和北区两个部分，以绿园（校内公园）分隔
landmarks.look: An on-campus green park separating residential areas.

landmarks.name: 体育场
landmarks.quote: 2014年，北京航空航天大学体育场告示牌出现语法错误
landmarks.look: A university athletic stadium with a track and field.

landmarks.name: 学五食堂
landmarks.quote: 2003年9月18日，北航学五食堂改制后重新开业
landmarks.look: A plain university dining hall building.

landmarks.name: 大学生活动中心
landmarks.quote: 曾在学院路校区的大学生活动中心（已拆除）内设有专门的办公室
landmarks.look: A plain campus activity hall building, now demolished.
